name: Jewelry
description: Guidelines for traveling with jewelry in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Jewelry (rings, necklaces, watches) is allowed in carry-on. Wearing or carrying valuable jewelry in the cabin is highly recommended to prevent loss or theft.

checkedBag.reason: Jewelry is allowed in checked baggage, though checked bags are not recommended for high-value items.
